title: Parsons invokes Bartzabel against Hubbard

tellings.quote: Parsons, furious, attempted a magical counterattack, invoking the spirit of Mars, Bartzabel, in a Miami hotel room.

plain: In 1946 the rocket engineer and occultist Jack Parsons, furious with L. Ron Hubbard, is said to have struck back with magic: in a Miami hotel room he called up Bartzabel, a spirit of the planet Mars. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about pagan ritual and secret science in the early days of American rocketry.
